results.title: Auber 89
results.overview: Aubervilliers, a Parisian working-class suburb, in the 1980s: Fatsah Bouyahmed, then in his teens, recalls the past and revives solidarity-filled life stories from the archive footage.

results.title: Kudrat 1968: High Council
results.overview: When Abbas returned to KUDRAT, the school was suddenly besieged by authorities following the death of a student, a tragedy the administration had long kept hidden. Tensions between the elite students and the scholarship students reached a breaking point. While Piji was determined to bring down Pa, Abbas and Kuda fought to uphold justice and expose the dark secrets threatening the entire institution.

results.title: MEAT
results.overview: A homeless family accepts shelter in a luxurious, remote ranch. What they don’t know is that their arrival was anticipated, and the baby they’re expecting is the main course of a hungry system.

results.title: Flowers Bloom When Touched
results.overview: When a bride-to-be must prove her purity for her impending arranged marriage, she attempts the impossible: restoring her virginity.

results.title: An Eternal Sound
results.overview: In the heart of rural North Carolina, Tom Lewtak pursues perfection in one of the oldest and most complex living crafts: Pipe organ building. This meditative journey follows the creation of a new organ, exploring the transcendent resonance of an eternal sound.

results.title: Lionheart
results.overview: Having grown up in the suburbs of Copenhagen, Luan knows the underworld and its rules better than any other life. That’s where he's belonged all his life. Now he wants to get out. The idea is simple. The reality is anything but. Old ties are not severed by a single decision. Issa has been by Luan's side since childhood, almost like a brother in a world where loyalty matters more than blood. A new beginning is not like putting on a clean shirt. You can change your address, your clothes and the company you keep, but the old rules remain. The body remembers how to stand. The eyes know who to trust.

results.title: It's a Good Thing Mom Doesn't Know
results.overview: On the eve of their mother's birthday, three find themselves, in one way or another, at the mercy of a powerful cartel and, unbenknownst to each other, begin working towards a common goal of taking them down. All the while, said mother, unaware of the bloody path her children are currently carving to ensure their family's safety, is busy making preparations for tommorow's celebration. That is, if the morning ever comes.

results.title: Skybreaker
results.overview: An Albanian girl born with ‘the gift’ embarks on a dangerous quest to rescue her lover from a dark sorceress.

results.title: City of Fathers
results.overview: A father and son have nothing in common except a first name, Richard, and an apartment on a housing estate. The burly, good-natured, 30-something factory worker listens to heavy metal and occasionally lets his girlfriend into his life. The frail, retired teacher, who raised the boy after his mother’s departure, is the embodiment of care and understanding. However, their tranquil, shared reality, which embraces both the hardcore band Našrot and Bergman’s “Cries and Whispers,” is disrupted by the sudden death of the mother. Young Richard sets out on a peculiar initiation journey with bizarre encounters and moments of unexpected enlightenment.

results.title: Tame
results.original_title: เลี้ยงไม่เชื่อง
results.overview: In a remote village where bulls are trained through fear and tradition, a young girl held captive by her family seeks the power of an ancient spirit for liberation, employing the same cruel techniques used to control her.

results.title: Greatest Performance
results.overview: During a film shoot where abuse is disguised as artistic direction, a comeback actress commits a devastating performance to survive, exposing how cinema can construct and legitimize violence.  In Ang Lihim ni Teresa (Teresa's Secret), she enters a set where authority is absolute and cruelty is framed as discipline. As production unfolds, she loses control over body, emotion, and authorship, where survival is mistaken for consent.  When violence escalates, she chooses to live, burying the truth as the director’s collapse is rewritten as myth. The set becomes a crime scene without witnesses.  In the aftermath, she is praised for her “courage” while a sound technician retreats into silence. At a commemorative screening, celebration fractures, revealing cinema’s ability to transform violence into narrative and absolution.  The myth of the Kataw appears briefly through Ang Lihim ng Kataw (The Secret of Kataw).

results.title: The Doll Ghawiah
results.overview: It all began with an accident on Babakan Siliwangi Road. Nala encountered a mysterious little girl and her doll in the Babakan Siliwangi forest. The doll’s name was Ghawiah, which means “lost.” Ever since that accident, many strange occurrences have begun to haunt the local residents.

results.title: My Own Bed Eating Me Alive
results.overview: Ramaz and Liza often spend time together, tasting soda and listening to electronic music. Ramaz bought some pineapples and dreams of treating Liza to some. Liza gave Ramaz a T-shirt, and he always wears it around the house.

results.title: The Longest Wait
results.overview: The first feature-length documentary on the journey of the Indonesian National Team. From the struggles on the pitch to capturing moments in the Indonesian national team's dressing room to qualify FIFA World Cup 2026

results.title: Unsafe
results.overview: When a young girl becomes trapped inside an airtight safe, firefighter Alex and her partner Jakob are called to a high-pressure rescue with minutes to spare. As oxygen runs out and the girl’s frantic parents demand action, cracks begin to appear in their story. What starts as a desperate life-saving mission quickly unravels into something far more sinister. With time slipping away, Alex and Jakob must uncover the truth behind the child, the couple and the safe itself — before the clock runs out.

results.title: Un tranquillo funerale di famiglia
results.overview: The day of the funeral of the patriarch of the Mancuso family, long-repressed grudges re-emerge between his children Daria and Riccardo. A solemn ceremony reveals the frailties and contradictions of a family that is anything but perfect.

results.title: Tenfa
results.overview: In the remote Himalayan village of Kandar, a midwife faces a life-threatening childbirth with no medical recourse. Her only hope lies in finding a wild herb known to heal such cases. The lone person who can identify this herb is an elderly grandmother, living with her teenage granddaughter. So as the three women journey in search - across lands scarred by hydropower projects, they uncover the erosion of both ecology and memory. When an old Kinnauri folksong becomes their guide, tradition and technology converge to revive a fading language, a disappearing landscape, and deep kinship between their people and the earth.

results.title: Our Kind of Chaos
results.overview: In the early 1990s, a group of misfit teenagers clashed with the vision skiers had for their mountains—they ended up revolutionizing snowboarding through the highly-controversial WHISKEY videos. Their story is one of excess, irreverence and rebellion—with a wake of triumphs and tragedies that put snowboarding on the map of the mainstream. They revolutionized winter sports as a whole, with a cultural impact so massive that it ultimately helped spawn the creation of Jackass. But that's not the real story here. In the present day, as these iconic teenagers are now nearing their 60s, they have the benefit of hindsight and years of introspection. What made them turn to a lifestyle that is so self-destructive? What formed this bond they all share that's lasted through 30+ years of friendship? The truth of it is a revelation—what starts as a documentary about modern snowboarding's creation turns to a treatise on how childhood shapes and follows us into adulthood.
